name: Squidbillies
summary: Watch the Squidbillies as the Cuylers kick the ass of America's toughest issues, including marriage inequality, taint cancer, speciesism, and the impending Russian snake apocalypse. It's good clean family fun for childless families!

name: The Daily Show with Jon Stewart
summary:
One anchor, several correspondents, zero credibility.

If you're tired of the stodginess of the evening newscasts and you can't bear to sit through the spinmeisters and shills on the 24-hour cable news network, don't miss The Daily Show with Jon Stewart.

name: Scorpion
summary: Scorpion is a high-octane drama about eccentric genius Walter O'Brien and his team of brilliant misfits who defend the nation from high-tech threats.

name: Red Band Society
summary: Red Band Society explores life, friendship, and love through the eyes of teenagers living together in a hospital.

name: Eureka
summary: Eureka is about a hidden town populated by the world's greatest scientific minds, where experiments often go disastrously wrong.

name: Bitten
summary: Bitten follows Elena Michaels, the world's only female werewolf, struggling between her normal life and her supernatural destiny.

name: The Mysteries of Laura
summary: The Mysteries of Laura centers on a brilliant NYPD detective juggling homicide cases and chaotic family life.

name: Hostages
summary: Hostages tells the story of a surgeon whose family is taken hostage to force her to assassinate the President.
